Linking your booking software? Ninety-nine to three hundred more.
Busy month? Extra minutes: twelve to thirty-five cents each.

Pain, swelling, bleeding? Straight to a human.
Three: privacy.
Patient data? Canadian privacy law applies.
Get these five answers, in writing.
Four: your thirty-day plan.
